cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Not That Subject
cards.instruction: Choose one subject you cannot let the scene reach. Redirect whenever the conversation gets close.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The rent letter may wait until I've approved our new curtains. Hold that end up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I open it now? The landlord wants an answer today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may answer with a photograph. He should see how well we're looking after his property.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send one and ask whether we're behind on rent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That question is not approved. Crop out the carpet first. I'll inspect the message before you're permitted to send it.

reason: Make control of the landlord reply the actual avoidance tactic: B useful combined solution forces A to impose editing and sending approval.
